idea-plugin.name: Proto Wire Break Check
idea-plugin.description:
Names the .proto edits that keep compiling and quietly change what old gRPC readers see

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Proto Wire Break Check: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/proto-wire-break-check (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/proto-wire-break-check

action.text: Proto Wire Break Check: Check This File
action.description: Run Proto Wire Break Check on the file in the editor
